notes.title: Single player Survival Mode and more
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Chefs! 👨‍🍳🔥[/h3][p]We’ve just served up a hot new update for [b]Kitchen Wars[/b], and it’s packed with flavor![/p][p][/p][h3]🧪 [b]Practice Mode[/b][/h3][p]New to the chaos? Want to test your weapons and skills?
[b]Practice Mode[/b] is here to let you explore the game mechanics without pressure.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181785/47f4287eeab80f15cbc762b5b1e0412f67d17479.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🧄 [b]New Survival Mode (Single Player)[/b][/h3][p]Defend your beloved kitchen from [b]endless waves of attackers[/b] in our brand-new [b]Single Player Survival Mode[/b]!
How long can you hold the line? How many waves can you survive?[/p][p]Get your gloves, set those traps, and prepare for the ultimate solo kitchen showdown![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181785/090e5da385d694f4defffcdb4bc12033ed0f64ba.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]❄️ [b]New PvP Item: Frost Bomb[/b][/h3][p]We’ve also added a [b]new throwable item[/b] in PvP — the [b]Frost Bomb[/b]! Freeze your enemies in place and serve up a cold dish of destruction![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181785/a3f2bb04c6dbc47a290479b58e7986302770c7a9.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🏆 [b]Global Leaderboard[/b][/h3][p]Track your score and see how you stack up against other culinary warriors!
Survive longer, score higher, and [b]climb the leaderboard[/b] for ultimate bragging rights.[/p][p]🛠️ [b]Challenges and prizes[/b] will be added soon , so keep an eye out![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181785/9f3a6caebd2588b8bf9387121ead0548d6de7e32.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Get back in the kitchen and show the world who’s the true master of the chaos!
Update your game now and let the food fight begin![/p][p]👨‍🍳 [i]Team Kitchen Wars[/i][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update V0.6.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181785/ce978b175cbfcae292f58ab9017f6e735c8ee5fb.png[/img]



[list]
[*] Various bug fixes.
[*] Improved gameplay visibility.
[*] Added rematch button at the end of the game.
[*] You can briefly pickup enemy players in their own restaurant.
[*] Restaurants no longer take damage from empty chair spots when low on health.
[*] Added a "Hide Room Code" option for streaming.
[/list]

notes.title: Kitchen Wars is Out Now on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]🍳 Kitchen Wars is Out Now on Steam! 🍔[/h1]

The wait is over, chefs! After the chaos, laughter, and delicious mayhem of the Appetizer Version, the full version of Kitchen Wars is finally LIVE on Steam!

💥 Run your chaotic restaurant
🥊 Brawl with other chefs
🧄 Steal, sabotage, and survive the madness

Whether you're in it to serve the best dishes or just ruin your friend's kitchen, the full experience is here—packed with new features, more maps, unlockables, and extra spicy party-game fun!

🟢 Play now: Kitchen Wars on Steam

👨‍🍳 Don't forget to:

Follow our Steam page to stay updated on patches, events, and new content!

Join the official Discord to find matches, report bugs, share memes, and talk with the devs and community: [url=https://discord.com/invite/94X9c4fWUk]Join Discord[/url]

See you in the kitchen... if you can survive it. 🔪🔥

— The Kitchen Wars Team
